strings.name: Lionel Messi
strings.summary: Messi has shaped global football through scoring, playmaking and sustained elite performance. He progressed from Barcelona’s academy to club records, then played for Paris Saint-Germain and Inter Miami. He won the Copa América and the 2022 World Cup with Argentina. After ending his international career in 2026, he continued playing club football.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026, with selected events through November 2026. International retirement is distinguished from continued club football; award totals refer to the stated periods.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: World Cup and Copa América
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Won the 2021 Copa América and 2022 World Cup with Argentina, receiving the 2022 World Cup Golden Ball.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Eight Ballon d’Or awards
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Won eight Ballon d’Or awards from 2009 to 2023, reflecting sustained performance at the highest level.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: Barcelona records
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Made 778 first-team appearances and scored 672 goals for Barcelona, establishing major club records.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: 18th World 11 selection
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Selected for the FIFPRO World 11 for the 18th time, his first inclusion since 2023.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Argentina farewell
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Made his farewell appearance against Benin after announcing international retirement on 31 August.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Eighth Ballon d’Or
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Received his eighth award after a season featuring World Cup victory.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Joins Inter Miami
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Signed for Inter Miami after leaving Paris Saint-Germain, moving to Major League Soccer.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Wins the World Cup
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Captained Argentina to victory over France and received the tournament’s Golden Ball.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Moves to Paris Saint-Germain
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Signed with PSG after his long Barcelona career.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Wins the Copa América
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Argentina defeated Brazil in the final, giving Messi his first major senior international title.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: First Ballon d’Or
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Won the award while at Barcelona, beginning a sequence of eight wins.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Competitive Barcelona debut
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Made his first-team competitive debut in a league match against Espanyol.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Rosario
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in Argentina; moved to Barcelona for football development as a teenager.
strings.influence.rationale: A World Cup champion and multiple Ballon d’Or winner whose influence reaches global football and popular culture.
